name: desktop-keepalive
description: Keeps Claude Desktop alive on Windows and your sessions reachable from the phone: relaunches the app after a crash, quit, update or Windows restart, and wakes your recent sessions so they reconnect to Remote Control - without spending model tokens.

wakeCount.title: Sessions to wake
wakeCount.description: How many of your most recent sessions to wake after Claude restarts.

alwaysWakeSessionIds.title: Always wake these sessions
alwaysWakeSessionIds.description: Comma-separated session ids (local_...) to wake after every restart even when they are not among the most recent ones. Leave empty for none.

wakeMessage.title: Wake-up message
wakeMessage.description: The message sent to each woken session.
wakeMessage.default: הודעה אוטומטית: קלוד הופעל מחדש, ונשלחה אליך הודעה כדי להעיר אותך מחדש ולחבר אותך שוב לנייד. אל תבצע שום פעולה ואל תקרא לשום כלי. ענה בשתי מילים בלבד: "התעוררתי מחדש"

taskId.title: Wake task id
taskId.description: The id of the scheduled task that carries the [[desktop-keepalive]] marker. Its finished runs are archived so the session list stays clean.

archiveOldRuns.title: Archive finished task runs
archiveOldRuns.description: Archive (never delete) earlier finished runs of the wake task.
